It names winds as heralds before mercy and sends down purifying water, giving a close parallel to the opening of the focus.
It states the rain's purpose of reviving dead land and watering creatures, extending the focus from reception to benefit.
It joins sent fertilizing winds with water sent from heaven and held in divine control, directly clarifying the wind-to-rain sequence.
It identifies sky-sent water as drink and pasture, supplying the ordinary benefit behind the recipients' joy.
